integration_status: Shared inventory of every unchanged Complexitylib and CSLib module vendored under vendor/. It merges the IPPSPACE inventory (238 Complexitylib modules, reviewed 2026-10-13) and the Toda inventory (193 Complexitylib modules, reviewed 2026-10-14); the 175 overlapping modules have identical checksums. All 256 Complexitylib and 4 CSLib modules build on the pinned local rc2 stack. scripts/check-upstream.py verifies every checksum and rejects duplicate, missing, or unrecorded vendor Lean files.

IPPSPACE.status: Complete: unconditional IPPSPACE.ip_eq_pspace uses unchanged upstream IP and PSPACE definitions and IP_subset_PSPACE. All required imports (238 Complexitylib and 4 CSLib modules) build on the pinned local rc2 stack and pass the expanded axiom audit. Full-package migration is optional.

Toda.status: 193 unchanged Complexitylib modules and four unchanged CSLib modules build on the pinned local rc2 stack and pass the complete module-origin axiom audit. Toda.toda proves canonical PH is contained in the full binary-answer machine-based PSharpP class; Toda.toda_charged also charges every returned answer bit. The proof includes exact canonical SharpP/GapP witness characterizations, uniform counting closure and amplification, canonical parity predicates with actual FP hashing and repetition adapters, randomized existential closure and PH induction, and costed query preparation, full-answer batch execution, and ordinary postprocessing. No unproved model bridge, custom axiom, sorry, or native_decide is used.
